theme: Client satisfaction, lower costs and lower total cost of ownership
source_title: Archi sample model: goals and principles

initiatives.title: One-stop service
initiatives.evidence: Archi principle: One Stop. Customers deal with one point of contact for every product and claim, so customer data and service must be shared across product lines.

initiatives.title: Faster claim treatment
initiatives.evidence: Archi principle: Treatment Time. Claims are handled within a set time, which needs digital notification, triage and payment.

initiatives.title: Shared application components
initiatives.evidence: Archi principle: Component. Product lines share components such as customer data and policy data instead of running their own systems.

initiatives.title: Standard infrastructure
initiatives.evidence: Archi principle: Infrastructure. Applications run on a small set of standard platforms.

initiatives.title: Licence rationalisation
initiatives.evidence: Archi principle: Licence. Fewer products and vendors, and licences matched to real use.

initiatives.title: Office occupancy
initiatives.evidence: Archi principle: Occupancy. Less paper and better use of office space, through digital document processing and collaboration.

initiatives.title: Digital self-service
initiatives.evidence: Illustrative. Quote, buy and change cover online for every product line, directly or through intermediaries.
